How text decorator works

Choose a frame, type your text, then copy the whole result. Frames preserve the words you enter; they add visible characters on each side.

Where it helps

A short frame can work for a display name or heading. Leave important links and addresses unframed, and check whether the destination counts the decoration toward a character limit.
